posts.subject: Recommendation and apology
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello Dear Dream Community,


I'm gonna write this thread not because @Luckiris and @WHAT are my friends I'm gonna write here a non biased opinion about them.


Starting of with @WHAT


He is a nice and supportive guy that you can spend time playing on game servers with, you can also have a nice and relaxed conversation with him regarding non Dream stuff as friend with friend would have, he has been supporting me with a lot of stuff and of course everyone has some negative points sometimes you get angry but do not show this on server which is a great part about you, you have been in the admin team long enough and many people trust you.


Moving onto @Luckiris


You're a nice and supportive guy also both you and what try to talk to me and support me when I'm sad which is great move from you, this shows community has some good people, you're also great with coding and fun to play portal 2 with also you have your moments too like everyone does because you stated the same thing to me "We all are humans, we all make mistakes no matter what and should not be judged because of the mistakes" I like the support you create for the Dream community


@MistaHT


You're a great member of the community I enjoy playing with you different games which are Rainbow Six Siege ( Autist shield guy 😏 ) or gambling with you on TTT server which you know what I mean, you also helped and supported me when I was sad a lot, thank you.


Moving onto the apology


@Nachtfrische @Hypnoxas


I would like to apologize for my behavior that occurred on ts3 this night and what after I wrote on shoutbox, I don't know what happened maybe because I used to be trolled by you guys a lot when there used to be Doo Doo and Elroy in team but this was out of nowhere and I though the "serious talk" was not serious after you nacht wrote "Serious mode: activated" this just seemed weired for me because it looked like you joked about talking with @wickedy which you did not and wanna apologize for this, my mistakes were made and I understand your decision guys.


Hope you guys and the community will be able to forgive me one day possibly in the future, I don't expect a lot just forgiveness we all make mistakes and suffer punishment for this, hope I'm still welcomed in this community and you guys did not start hate me.


You can state your honest answer and opinion here, anything is welcome, you can tell me how to improve and how I could implement this improvements into me.

At least you regret your actions. 🙄


However, you should stop being so sensitive imo

Again?


WTF!

the only way to improve is growing up and getting older i really don't see anymore options.
